W.note: Tidy teal toast with ETA, tracking number and action buttons, but no reduced-motion handling, no progress count and a floating-in animation that jumps.

X.note: Best accessibility (switch roles, region, status, reduced motion) and a very small collapsed bar, but the opened panel has a big empty gap and tiny type.

Y.note: Compact amber toast with dot progress, check-mark timeline and clean connectors; lacks a copyable tracking number and a full ETA time but has the best density and polish.

Z.note: Richest tracking (ETA window, progress bar, locations, copy number, actions) with a smooth expand, though the opened toast is taller than it needs to be.
